WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(orders.order_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS "orders.order_date",
    SUM(orders.amount) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(orders.order_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE)
), _cm_orders__customers__score_max AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(customers.score) AS "score_max"
  FROM customers AS customers
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.order_date",
    CAST(CAST(_base."orders.amount_sum" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(_cm_orders__customers__score_max."score_max", 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "a",
    _base."orders.amount_sum",
    _cm_orders__customers__score_max."score_max" AS "customers.score_max"
  FROM _base
  CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__customers__score_max
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.amount_sum",
    "a",
    "customers.score_max",
    CAST(SUM("a") OVER (ORDER BY "orders.order_date") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "orders._cumsum_inner"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  "orders.order_date",
  "a"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.amount_sum",
    "a",
    "customers.score_max",
    "orders._cumsum_inner"
  FROM step1
  WHERE
    "orders._cumsum_inner" > 9
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.order_date" ASC
